_comment: THE SYLLABUS. This file is the boss's, and it is the only place the Scholar is told what
to care about. Edit it freely: the daemon re-reads it at the top of every tick, so a
topic added here is studied without restarting anything, and a weight changed here
changes the rotation on the next tick rather than the next boot.
weight     how much of the Scholar's attention this topic deserves, relative to the
others. A weight of 3 against a weight of 1 is studied roughly three times
as often. Zero parks a topic without deleting what it already learned.
queries    what to search the web gate for. The same door a conversational question
youtube    either a full watch URL or a plain phrase. A phrase becomes a yt-dlp search
for one result; a URL is taken as given. Leave empty to study articles only.
revenue_goals  carried into the thinking prompt verbatim, because a bullet that does not
serve one of these is off-syllabus and the Poison Guard is entitled to say so.
revenue_goals: one product that earns while I sleep
an audience that trusts me before it buys from me
revenue that does not depend on my hours

topics.youtube: how founders should think about personal finance
